<div id="hwm-root"></div>
<style>
  #hwm-root { max-width:780px; margin:0 auto; padding:4px 0; color:#1f2933; text-align:left;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:16px; line-height:1.3; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-bar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg { display:inline-flex; background:#eef1f4; border-radius:9px; padding:3px; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg button { border:0; margin:0; background:transparent; padding:6px 13px; border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer;
                font-family:inherit; font-size:15px; line-height:1.2; color:#7b8794; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:normal;
                transition:background .25s, color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg button.hwm-on { background:#ffffff; color:#1f2933; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }
  #hwm-root .hwm-cap { font-size:14px; color:#7b8794; margin:8px 2px 0; min-height:20px; }
  #hwm-root svg { width:100%; height:auto; display:block; margin:0; max-height:none; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-ax { transition:opacity .6s ease; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-tick { font-size:13px; fill:#7b8794; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-lab { font-size:14px; fill:#1f2933; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-leg { font-size:13px; fill:#1f2933; transition:opacity .4s; }
</style>

50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110], "xlab": "Height (cm)", "ylab": "Weight (kg)", "xshort": "height", "yshort": "weight", "groups": [{"key": "W", "label": "Women", "color": "#d53f8c"}, {"key": "M", "label": "Men", "color": "#2b6cb0"}], "capJoint": "Joint distribution: each dot is one student (height, weight)", "capX": "Empirical marginal of height: every dot falls onto the x-axis", "capY": "Empirical marginal of weight: every dot falls onto the y-axis"};
  const P = 'hwm', CFG = CFG_P;
  const root = document.getElementById(P + '-root');
  const W = 760, H = 470, m = { l: 62, r: 20, t: 16, b: 54 };
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
  const [x0, x1] = CFG.xdom, [y0, y1] = CFG.ydom;
  const sx = v => m.l + (v - x0) / (x1 - x0) * pw;
  const sy = v => m.t + ph - (v - y0) / (y1 - y0) * ph;
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const el = (t, a, p) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, t);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); if (p) p.appendChild(e); return e; };

  // ---------- controls ----------
  const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = P + '-bar'; root.appendChild(bar);
  function seg(opts, init, cb) {
    const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = P + '-seg'; const bs = {};
    opts.forEach(([k, l]) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.textContent = l;
      b.onclick = () => { if (b.classList.contains(P + '-on')) return; for (const kk in bs) bs[kk].classList.toggle(P + '-on', kk === k); cb(k); };
      bs[k] = b; s.appendChild(b);
    });
    bs[init].classList.add(P + '-on'); bar.appendChild(s);
  }
  let mode = 'joint', filt = 'all';
  seg([['joint', 'Joint'], ['mx', 'Marginal of ' + CFG.xshort], ['my', 'Marginal of ' + CFG.yshort]],
      'joint', k => { mode = k; update(); });
  if (CFG.groups) seg([['all', 'All'], ...CFG.groups.map(g => [g.key, g.label])],
      'all', k => { filt = k; update(); });
  const cap = document.createElement('div'); cap.className = P + '-cap'; root.appendChild(cap);

  // ---------- axes ----------
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: 'img', 'aria-label': CFG.title }, root);
  const xAx = el('g', { class: P + '-ax' }, svg), yAx = el('g', { class: P + '-ax' }, svg);
  CFG.yticks.forEach(v => {
    el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: sy(v), y2: sy(v), stroke: '#edf0f3' }, yAx);
    el('text', { x: m.l - 10, y: sy(v) + 4.5, 'text-anchor': 'end', class: P + '-tick' }, yAx).textContent = v;
  });
  CFG.xticks.forEach(v => {
    el('line', { x1: sx(v), x2: sx(v), y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#edf0f3' }, xAx);
    el('text', { x: sx(v), y: m.t + ph + 22, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-tick' }, xAx).textContent = v;
  });
  el('text', { x: m.l + pw / 2, y: H - 8, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab' }, xAx).textContent = CFG.xlab;
  el('text', { x: 16, y: m.t + ph / 2, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab',
               transform: `rotate(-90 16 ${m.t + ph / 2})` }, yAx).textContent = CFG.ylab;
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: m.t + ph, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l, y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);

  // legend (groups only)
  const legItems = {};
  if (CFG.groups) CFG.groups.forEach((g, i) => {
    const gg = el('g', { class: P + '-leg', transform: `translate(${m.l + pw - 150 + i * 80}, ${m.t + 6})` }, svg);
    el('circle', { cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 5, fill: g.color }, gg);
    el('text', { x: 10, y: 4.5 }, gg).textContent = g.label;
    legItems[g.key] = gg;
  });

  // ---------- dots (constant size throughout) ----------
  const R = CFG.r || 4.3, OP = 0.82;
  const G = 0.0011;                 // gravity, px / ms^2
  const dotsG = el('g', {}, svg);
  const color = d => CFG.groups ? CFG.groups.find(g => g.key === d.g).color : CFG.color;
  const pts = CFG.data.map(d => ({ g: d.g, dx: d.x, dy: d.y,
    c: el('circle', { r: R, fill: color(d), stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 0.8, opacity: 0 }, dotsG),
    x: sx(d.x), y: sy(d.y), op: 0, segs: [], pile: null }));
  const active = p => filt === 'all' || p.g === filt;
  const home = p => ({ x: sx(p.dx), y: sy(p.dy) });

  // pile frame: v = lateral coordinate, u = height above the "floor" (the axis the dots fall onto)
  const toVU = (dim, x, y) => dim === 'x' ? { v: x, u: m.t + ph - y } : { v: y, u: x - m.l };
  const toXY = (dim, v, u) => dim === 'x' ? { x: v, y: m.t + ph - u } : { x: m.l + u, y: v };

  // drop one disk at lateral position v0 onto the floor / existing disks; it may roll a little sideways into a lower spot
  function deposit(v0, placed, vTrue = v0, maxDrift = 3 * R) {
    const restU = v => { let u = R;
      for (const q of placed) { const dv = v - q.v; if (dv > -2 * R && dv < 2 * R) u = Math.max(u, q.u + Math.sqrt(4 * R * R - dv * dv)); }
      return u; };
    let best = null;
    for (let dl = -1.6 * R; dl <= 1.6 * R; dl += 0.25) {
      if (Math.abs(v0 + dl - vTrue) > maxDrift) continue;        // never let a dot wander far from its true value
      const u = restU(v0 + dl), cost = u + 0.3 * Math.abs(dl);
      if (!best || cost < best.cost) best = { v: v0 + dl, u, cost };
    }
    return best;
  }
  // build a pile from the given dots, dropped in order of current height above the floor (lowest lands first).
  // Then re-release the settled pile a few times until it stops changing, so the first drop already lands in its final, smooth shape.
  function buildPile(dim, list, placed, passes = 15) {
    const base = placed.slice();
    const orig = new Map(list.map(p => [p, toVU(dim, p.x, p.y)]));   // true data position: rolling is always measured from here
    let start = orig;
    for (let k = 0; k < passes; k++) {
      const pl = base.slice();
      list.slice().sort((a, b) => start.get(a).u - start.get(b).u).forEach(p => {
        const r = deposit(start.get(p).v, pl, orig.get(p).v); pl.push(r); p.pile = { v: r.v, u: r.u };
      });
      const moved = k === 0 ? Infinity : list.reduce((s, p) => s + Math.abs(p.pile.v - start.get(p).v) + Math.abs(p.pile.u - start.get(p).u), 0);
      start = new Map(list.map(p => [p, p.pile]));
      if (moved < 0.5) break;
    }
    list.forEach(p => placed.push({ v: p.pile.v, u: p.pile.u }));
  }
  // ---------- animation segments ----------
  const ease = u => u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3) / 2;
  const smooth = u => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  let clock = 0, raf = null;
  // each segment: {t0, dur, kind, ...}; positions evaluated relative to the segment start
  function addFall(p, dim, from, to, t0) {
    const a = toVU(dim, from.x, from.y), b = toVU(dim, to.x, to.y), D = Math.max(0, a.u - b.u);
    const T = Math.max(60, Math.sqrt(2 * D / G));
    p.segs.push({ t0, dur: T, kind: 'fall', dim, a, b, D });
    const amp = Math.min(3.5, 0.9 * G * T * 3);             // tiny bounce scaled by impact speed
    p.segs.push({ t0: t0 + T, dur: 170, kind: 'bounce', dim, b, amp });
    return t0 + T + 170;
  }
  function addMove(p, from, to, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'move', from, to }); return t0 + dur; }
  function addFade(p, o0, o1, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'fade', o0, o1 }); }

  function evalP(p, t) {
    for (const s of p.segs) {
      if (t < s.t0) continue;
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / s.dur);
      if (s.kind === 'fade') { p.op = s.o0 + (s.o1 - s.o0) * u; continue; }
      let q;
      if (s.kind === 'move') { const k = ease(u); q = { x: s.from.x + (s.to.x - s.from.x) * k, y: s.from.y + (s.to.y - s.from.y) * k }; }
      else if (s.kind === 'fall') {

        const roll = smooth(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - 0.65) / 0.35)));   // sideways roll only at the end of the fall
        q = toXY(s.dim, s.a.v + (s.b.v - s.a.v) * roll, s.a.u - fallen);

    for (const p of pts) {

      p.c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('opacity', p.op.toFixed(3));
    }

  }

  let shown = 'joint';                      // what the dots currently form
  function update(changed) {
    start();
    const n = pts.filter(active).length;
    cap.textContent = (mode === 'joint' ? CFG.capJoint : mode === 'mx' ? CFG.capX : CFG.capY) + `   ·   n = ${n}`;
    xAx.style.opacity = mode === 'my' ? 0 : 1;
    yAx.style.opacity = mode === 'mx' ? 0 : 1;
    for (const k in legItems) legItems[k].style.opacity = (filt === 'all' || filt === k) ? 1 : 0.25;

    // fades for filter changes
    const entering = [], leaving = [];
    pts.forEach(p => {
      const on = active(p), vis = p.op > 0.01;
      if (on && !vis) entering.push(p);
      if (!on && vis) { leaving.push(p); addFade(p, p.op, 0, 0, 350); p.pile = null; }
    });

    if (mode === 'joint') {
      pts.filter(active).forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 400); }
        else addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 180, 850);
      });

    }

    const dim = mode === 'mx' ? 'x' : 'y';
    const act = pts.filter(active);
    if (shown !== mode) {
      // lift everything back to its scatter position first (if not already there), then let gravity act
      const lift = shown === 'joint' ? 0 : 750;
      act.forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 300); }
        else if (lift) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 120, lift - 120);
      });
      const placed = []; const src = act.map(p => ({ p, x: home(p).x, y: home(p).y }));
      // pile computed from scatter positions
      src.forEach(o => { o.p._x = o.p.x; o.p._y = o.p.y; o.p.x = o.x; o.p.y = o.y; });
      buildPile(dim, act, placed);
      src.forEach(o => { o.p.x = o.p._x; o.p.y = o.p._y; });
      act.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), lift + 150 + Math.random() * 120));
    } else {
      // same marginal, filter changed: survivors re-settle downward, newcomers appear at their scatter spot and fall on top
      const stay = act.filter(p => !entering.includes(p));
      const placed = []; const t0 = leaving.length ? 300 : 0;
      buildPile(dim, stay, placed);
      stay.forEach(p => {
        const to = toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), cur = toVU(dim, p.x, p.y);
        if (cur.u - p.pile.u > 0.5) addFall(p, dim, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0 + Math.random() * 80);
        else if (Math.hypot(to.x - p.x, to.y - p.y) > 0.5) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0, 400);
      });
      entering.forEach(p => { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, t0, 300); });
      buildPile(dim, entering.map(p => p), placed);
      entering.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), t0 + 350 + Math.random() * 120));
    }
    shown = mode;
  }
  update();
})();
</script>

  }
  // ---------- animation segments ----------
  const ease = u => u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3) / 2;
  const smooth = u => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  let clock = 0, raf = null;
  // each segment: {t0, dur, kind, ...}; positions evaluated relative to the segment start
  function addFall(p, dim, from, to, t0) {
    const a = toVU(dim, from.x, from.y), b = toVU(dim, to.x, to.y), D = Math.max(0, a.u - b.u);
    const T = Math.max(60, Math.sqrt(2 * D / G));
    p.segs.push({ t0, dur: T, kind: 'fall', dim, a, b, D });
    const amp = Math.min(3.5, 0.9 * G * T * 3);             // tiny bounce scaled by impact speed
    p.segs.push({ t0: t0 + T, dur: 170, kind: 'bounce', dim, b, amp });
    return t0 + T + 170;
  }
  function addMove(p, from, to, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'move', from, to }); return t0 + dur; }
  function addFade(p, o0, o1, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'fade', o0, o1 }); }

  function evalP(p, t) {
    for (const s of p.segs) {
      if (t < s.t0) continue;
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / s.dur);
      if (s.kind === 'fade') { p.op = s.o0 + (s.o1 - s.o0) * u; continue; }
      let q;
      if (s.kind === 'move') { const k = ease(u); q = { x: s.from.x + (s.to.x - s.from.x) * k, y: s.from.y + (s.to.y - s.from.y) * k }; }
      else if (s.kind === 'fall') {
        const tt = u * s.dur, fallen = Math.min(s.D, 0.5 * G * tt * tt);
        const roll = smooth(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - 0.65) / 0.35)));   // sideways roll only at the end of the fall
        q = toXY(s.dim, s.a.v + (s.b.v - s.a.v) * roll, s.a.u - fallen);
      } else { q = toXY(s.dim, s.b.v, s.b.u + s.amp * Math.sin(Math.PI * u)); }
      p.x = q.x; p.y = q.y;
    }
  }
  function tick(now) {
    if (!clock) clock = now;
    const t = now - clock; let busy = false;
    for (const p of pts) {
      evalP(p, t);
      if (p.segs.some(s => t < s.t0 + s.dur)) busy = true;
      p.c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('opacity', p.op.toFixed(3));
    }
    raf = busy ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : null;
  }
  function start() {                       // freeze current state, start a fresh timeline
    pts.forEach(p => { p.segs = []; });
    clock = 0; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // ---------- state transitions ----------
  let shown = 'joint';                      // what the dots currently form
  function update(changed) {
    start();
    const n = pts.filter(active).length;
    cap.textContent = (mode === 'joint' ? CFG.capJoint : mode === 'mx' ? CFG.capX : CFG.capY) + `   ·   n = ${n}`;
    xAx.style.opacity = mode === 'my' ? 0 : 1;
    yAx.style.opacity = mode === 'mx' ? 0 : 1;
    for (const k in legItems) legItems[k].style.opacity = (filt === 'all' || filt === k) ? 1 : 0.25;

    // fades for filter changes
    const entering = [], leaving = [];
    pts.forEach(p => {
      const on = active(p), vis = p.op > 0.01;
      if (on && !vis) entering.push(p);
      if (!on && vis) { leaving.push(p); addFade(p, p.op, 0, 0, 350); p.pile = null; }
    });

    if (mode === 'joint') {
      pts.filter(active).forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 400); }
        else addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 180, 850);
      });
      shown = 'joint'; return;
    }

    const dim = mode === 'mx' ? 'x' : 'y';
    const act = pts.filter(active);
    if (shown !== mode) {
      // lift everything back to its scatter position first (if not already there), then let gravity act
      const lift = shown === 'joint' ? 0 : 750;
      act.forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 300); }
        else if (lift) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 120, lift - 120);
      });
      const placed = []; const src = act.map(p => ({ p, x: home(p).x, y: home(p).y }));
      // pile computed from scatter positions
      src.forEach(o => { o.p._x = o.p.x; o.p._y = o.p.y; o.p.x = o.x; o.p.y = o.y; });
      buildPile(dim, act, placed);
      src.forEach(o => { o.p.x = o.p._x; o.p.y = o.p._y; });
      act.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), lift + 150 + Math.random() * 120));
    } else {
      // same marginal, filter changed: survivors re-settle downward, newcomers appear at their scatter spot and fall on top
      const stay = act.filter(p => !entering.includes(p));
      const placed = []; const t0 = leaving.length ? 300 : 0;
      buildPile(dim, stay, placed);
      stay.forEach(p => {
        const to = toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), cur = toVU(dim, p.x, p.y);
        if (cur.u - p.pile.u > 0.5) addFall(p, dim, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0 + Math.random() * 80);
        else if (Math.hypot(to.x - p.x, to.y - p.y) > 0.5) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0, 400);
      });
      entering.forEach(p => { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, t0, 300); });
      buildPile(dim, entering.map(p => p), placed);
      entering.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), t0 + 350 + Math.random() * 120));
    }
    shown = mode;
  }
  update();
})();
</script>

<style>

</style>
<script>
(function () {
  const P = 'jgb', CFG = {"p": [[0.043478260869565216, 0.02608695652173913, 0.034782608695652174, 0.0], [0.02608695652173913, 0.11304347826086956, 0.08695652173913043, 0.008695652173913044], [0.02608695652173913, 0.10434782608695652, 0.30434782608695654, 0.0782608695652174], [0.0, 0.008695652173913044, 0.06956521739130435, 0.06956521739130435]], "xvals": ["1", "2", "3", "4"], "yvals": ["1", "2", "3", "4"], "xname": "X", "yname": "Y", "xlab": "X = Quiz 1 grade points", "ylab": "Y = Midterm grade points", "stretch": 1.5, "view": [40, 20], "defaultCond": [3, 3], "n": 115, "heat": true};
  const root = document.getElementById(P + '-root');
  const q = s => root.querySelector('.' + P + '-' + s);
  const svg = q('svg'), cap = q('cap'), info = q('info'), tabBox = q('tab'), condBox = q('cond');
  const W = 620, H = 470; svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);

  // ---------- model ----------
  const pm = CFG.p, nx = pm.length, ny = pm[0].length, XV = CFG.xvals, YV = CFG.yvals;
  const pX = pm.map(r => r.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0));
  const pY = YV.map((_, j) => pm.reduce((a, r) => a + r[j], 0));
  // tallest bar any view can show (joint, marginal or conditional); vertical scale is set so it is ~ CFG.stretch x the grid width
  const ZMAX = Math.max(...pX, ...pY, ...pm.flatMap((r, i) => r.map((v, j) => Math.max(pX[i] ? v / pX[i] : 0, pY[j] ? v / pY[j] : 0))));
  const HS = CFG.hs || (CFG.stretch || 0.9) * Math.max(nx, ny) / ZMAX, BW = 0.56;   // world units per unit probability
  const XW = -1.9, YW = ny - 1 + 1.9;                     // back walls (viewer sits in the +x, -y quadrant)
  const XST = -1.15, YST = ny - 1 + 1.15;                 // where marginal stacks form
  const XN = CFG.xname, YN = CFG.yname;
  const f3 = v => v.toFixed(3);

  const hex = h => [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  const BASE = hex('#3d72b8'), HIL = hex('#e07b2a');
  // optional heat map (CFG.heat): white-pink -> dark red, bars and table cells share the scale
  const STOPS = ['#fde0d2', '#fcae91', '#fb6a4a', '#de2d26', '#a50f15', '#67000d'].map(hex);
  const HM = Math.max(...pm.flat());
  const heatc = t => { t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)) * (STOPS.length - 1); const k = Math.min(STOPS.length - 2, Math.floor(t)), f = t - k;
    return STOPS[k].map((v, q) => Math.round(v + (STOPS[k + 1][q] - v) * f)); };
  const rgbs = c => `rgb(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]})`;
  const cellSty = (v, M) => { if (!CFG.heat) return ''; const t = v / M, c = v > 0 ? heatc(0.04 + 0.96 * t) : [244, 245, 247];
    return ` style="background:${rgbs(c)};color:${t > 0.55 ? '#ffffff' : '#1f2933'}"`; };

  const bars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
    const hc = CFG.heat ? heatc(0.04 + 0.96 * pm[i][j] / HM) : BASE;
    bars.push({ i, j, p: pm[i][j], x: i, y: j, z0: 0, h: pm[i][j] * HS, op: 1, hc, r: hc[0], g: hc[1], b: hc[2], lab: 0, labv: 0 });
  }
  const cam = { a: CFG.view[0], e: CFG.view[1], wallH: 0.4, cz: 0 };

  // ---------- projection ----------
  const rad = d => d * Math.PI / 180;
  let R, U, V, C;
  function setCam() {
    const a = rad(cam.a), e = rad(cam.e);
    R = [Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a), 0];
    U = [-Math.sin(e) * Math.cos(a), Math.sin(e) * Math.sin(a), Math.cos(e)];
    V = [Math.cos(a) * Math.cos(e), -Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(e), Math.sin(e)];
    C = [(XW + nx - 1 + 0.6) / 2, (-0.6 + YW) / 2, cam.cz];
  }
  const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
  let S = 60; const CX = W / 2, CY = H / 2 + 6;
  function pr(x, y, z) { const d = [x - C[0], y - C[1], z - C[2]]; return [CX + S * dot(d, R), CY - S * dot(d, U), dot(d, V)]; }
  // fixed zoom: fits the whole scene for every allowed camera angle, so rotating never zooms
  (function fit() {
    let best = Infinity; const save = { ...cam };
    for (const a of [0, 6, 22, CFG.view[0], 62, 84, 90]) for (const e of [13, 20, CFG.view[1]]) {   // the automatic views; manual drags may overflow slightly
      cam.a = a; cam.e = e; cam.cz = ZMAX * HS * 0.42; setCam(); S = 1;
      let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y0 = 1e9, y1 = -1e9;
      for (const X of [XW, nx - 1 + 0.9]) for (const Y of [-0.9, YW]) for (const Z of [0, ZMAX * HS + 0.4]) {
        const s = pr(X, Y, Z); x0 = Math.min(x0, s[0] - CX); x1 = Math.max(x1, s[0] - CX); y0 = Math.min(y0, s[1] - CY); y1 = Math.max(y1, s[1] - CY);
      }
      best = Math.min(best, (W / 2 - 30) / Math.max(-x0, x1), (H / 2 - 18) / Math.max(-y0, y1));
    }
    Object.assign(cam, save); S = best;
  })();

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  const rgb = (r, g, b, k) => `rgb(${Math.round(r * k)},${Math.round(g * k)},${Math.round(b * k)})`;
  const poly = (pts, fill, stroke, op, extra = '') =>
    `<polygon points="${pts.map(p => p[0].toFixed(1) + ',' + p[1].toFixed(1)).join(' ')}" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="${op.toFixed(3)}" ${extra}/>`;
  const txt = (p, s, cls, anchor = 'middle', dy = 0) =>
    `<text x="${p[0].toFixed(1)}" y="${(p[1] + dy).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="${anchor}" font-size="${cls === 'lab' ? 14 : 13}" fill="${cls === 'lab' ? '#1f2933' : '#7b8794'}" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif">${s}</text>`;

  function render() {
    setCam();
    let out = '';
    // back walls with probability gridlines
    const wh = cam.wallH * HS, xr = nx - 1 + 0.6, y0 = -0.6;
    out += poly([pr(XW, y0, 0), pr(XW, YW, 0), pr(XW, YW, wh), pr(XW, y0, wh)], '#fafbfc', '#e3e7ec', 1);
    out += poly([pr(XW, YW, 0), pr(xr, YW, 0), pr(xr, YW, wh), pr(XW, YW, wh)], '#fafbfc', '#e3e7ec', 1);
    for (let k = 1; k * 0.1 <= cam.wallH + 1e-9; k++) {
      const z = k * 0.1 * HS, a = pr(XW, y0, z), b = pr(XW, YW, z), c = pr(xr, YW, z);
      const strong = k % 2 === 0;
      out += `<polyline points="${a[0]},${a[1]} ${b[0]},${b[1]} ${c[0]},${c[1]}" fill="none" stroke="${strong ? '#e3e7ec' : '#f0f2f5'}" stroke-width="0.8"/>`;
      if (strong) out += txt(a, (k / 10).toFixed(1), 'tick', 'end', 4).replace('<text', '<text dx="-6"');
    }
    // floor footprints
    for (const b of bars) {
      const h = BW / 2 + 0.06, x = b.i, y = b.j;
      out += poly([pr(x - h, y - h, 0), pr(x + h, y - h, 0), pr(x + h, y + h, 0), pr(x - h, y + h, 0)], b.p > 0 ? '#eef1f5' : '#f6f7f9', '#e3e7ec', 1);
    }
    // axis tick labels and names on the two front edges
    const fx = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Math.abs(R[0]) - 0.3) / 0.3)), fy = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Math.abs(R[1]) - 0.3) / 0.3));
    const op = (s, o) => o < 1 ? s.replace('<text', `<text opacity="${o.toFixed(2)}"`) : s;
    if (fx > 0) { XV.forEach((v, i) => out += op(txt(pr(i, -0.95, 0), v, 'tick', 'middle', 10), fx));
                  out += op(txt(pr((nx - 1) / 2, -2.1, 0), CFG.xlab, 'lab', 'middle', 10), fx); }
    if (fy > 0) { YV.forEach((v, j) => out += op(txt(pr(nx - 1 + 0.95, j, 0), v, 'tick', 'middle', 10), fy));
                  out += op(txt(pr(nx - 1 + 2.1, (ny - 1) / 2, 0), CFG.ylab, 'lab', 'middle', 10), fy); }

    // bars, painter's order (far to near)
    const list = bars.filter(b => b.h > 1e-3 && b.op > 0.005)
      .map(b => ({ b, d: pr(b.x, b.y, b.z0 + b.h / 2)[2] })).sort((u, v) => u.d - v.d);
    const labels = [];
    for (const { b } of list) {
      const w = BW / 2, x0 = b.x - w, x1 = b.x + w, ya = b.y - w, yb = b.y + w, z0 = b.z0, z1 = b.z0 + b.h;
      const id = `data-i="${b.i}" data-j="${b.j}"`, st = rgb(b.r, b.g, b.b, 0.82);
      if (V[0] > 1e-6) out += poly([pr(x1, ya, z0), pr(x1, yb, z0), pr(x1, yb, z1), pr(x1, ya, z1)], rgb(b.r, b.g, b.b, 0.80), st, b.op, id);
      if (V[1] < -1e-6) out += poly([pr(x0, ya, z0), pr(x1, ya, z0), pr(x1, ya, z1), pr(x0, ya, z1)], rgb(b.r, b.g, b.b, 0.66), st, b.op, id);
      out += poly([pr(x0, ya, z1), pr(x1, ya, z1), pr(x1, yb, z1), pr(x0, yb, z1)], rgb(b.r, b.g, b.b, 1.0), st, b.op, id);
      if (b.lab > 0.02) labels.push({ p: pr(b.x, b.y, z1), s: f3(b.labv), op: b.lab });
    }
    for (const L of stackLabels()) labels.push(L);
    for (const L of labels) out += txt(L.p, L.s, 'lab', 'middle', -8).replace('<text', `<text opacity="${L.op.toFixed(2)}" font-weight="600"`);
    svg.innerHTML = out;
  }

  // ---------- tweens ----------
  let tweens = [], t0 = 0, raf = null;
  const ease = u => u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3) / 2;
  function tw(obj, key, to, start, dur) { tweens.push({ obj, key, from: null, to, start, dur }); }
  function tick(now) {
    if (!t0) t0 = now; const t = now - t0; let busy = false;
    for (const w of tweens) {
      if (t < w.start) { busy = true; continue; }
      if (w.from === null) w.from = w.obj[w.key];
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - w.start) / w.dur); if (u < 1) busy = true;
      w.obj[w.key] = w.from + (w.to - w.from) * ease(u);
    }
    render(); raf = busy ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : null;
  }
  function go() { t0 = 0; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); }

  // ---------- modes ----------
  let mode = 'joint', sel = null, stackOp = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  function stackLabels() {
    const L = [];
    if (stackOp.x > 0.02) XV.forEach((_, i) => L.push({ p: pr(i, YST, pX[i] * HS), s: f3(pX[i]), op: stackOp.x }));
    if (stackOp.y > 0.02) YV.forEach((_, j) => L.push({ p: pr(XST, j, pY[j] * HS), s: f3(pY[j]), op: stackOp.y }));
    return L;
  }
  function colorTo(b, c, s, d) { tw(b, 'r', c[0], s, d); tw(b, 'g', c[1], s, d); tw(b, 'b', c[2], s, d); }

  function setMode(m, v) {
    const prev = mode; mode = m; sel = v; tweens = [];
    const camTo = (a, e, s = 0, d = 1100) => { tw(cam, 'a', a, s, d); tw(cam, 'e', e, s, d); };
    let wall = Math.max(...pm.flat());
    tw(stackOp, 'x', 0, 0, 300); tw(stackOp, 'y', 0, 0, 300);

    if (m === 'joint') {
      bars.forEach(b => { tw(b, 'x', b.i, 0, 900); tw(b, 'y', b.j, 0, 900); tw(b, 'z0', 0, 0, 900); tw(b, 'h', b.p * HS, 0, 900);
        tw(b, 'op', 1, 0, 600); tw(b, 'lab', 0, 0, 300); colorTo(b, b.hc, 0, 600); });
      if (prev.startsWith('cond') || prev.startsWith('marg')) camTo(...CFG.view);
      cap.innerHTML = `Joint PMF: bar height at (<em>x</em>, <em>y</em>) is P(${XN} = <em>x</em>, ${YN} = <em>y</em>). All bar heights sum to 1.`;
    }
    if (m === 'mx' || m === 'my') {
      const isX = m === 'mx';
      // bars slide toward the back wall and stack: heights add up to the marginal
      bars.forEach(b => {
        const below = isX ? pm[b.i].slice(0, b.j).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) : pm.slice(0, b.i).reduce((s, r) => s + r[b.j], 0);
        const order = isX ? (ny - 1 - b.j) : b.i, st = order * 140;
        tw(b, isX ? 'y' : 'x', isX ? YST : XST, st, 950); tw(b, isX ? 'x' : 'y', isX ? b.i : b.j, st, 950);
        tw(b, 'z0', below * HS, st, 950); tw(b, 'h', b.p * HS, 0, 600);
        tw(b, 'op', 1, 0, 400); tw(b, 'lab', 0, 0, 300); colorTo(b, b.hc, 0, 400);
      });
      tw(stackOp, isX ? 'x' : 'y', 1, 1400, 500);
      wall = Math.max(...(isX ? pX : pY));
      camTo(isX ? 62 : 22, 20);
      cap.innerHTML = isX
        ? `Marginal of ${XN}: for each <em>x</em>, stack the bars along <em>y</em>. P(${XN} = <em>x</em>) = &Sigma;<sub><em>y</em></sub> P(${XN} = <em>x</em>, ${YN} = <em>y</em>).`
        : `Marginal of ${YN}: for each <em>y</em>, stack the bars along <em>x</em>. P(${YN} = <em>y</em>) = &Sigma;<sub><em>x</em></sub> P(${XN} = <em>x</em>, ${YN} = <em>y</em>).`;
    }
    if (m === 'cx' || m === 'cy') {
      const isX = m === 'cx', den = isX ? pX[v] : pY[v], val = isX ? XV[v] : YV[v];
      const inSlice = b => (isX ? b.i : b.j) === v;
      bars.forEach(b => {
        tw(b, 'x', b.i, 0, 700); tw(b, 'y', b.j, 0, 700); tw(b, 'z0', 0, 0, 700);
        if (inSlice(b)) {
          tw(b, 'h', b.p * HS, 0, 700); colorTo(b, CFG.heat ? b.hc : HIL, 0, 600); tw(b, 'op', 1, 0, 500);
          tw(b, 'h', den > 0 ? b.p / den * HS : 0, 1700, 1000);           // phase 2: divide by the marginal
          tw(b, 'lab', 1, 2700, 400); b.labv = den > 0 ? b.p / den : 0;
          if (CFG.heat) { const mc = Math.max(...bars.filter(inSlice).map(q => q.p / den)); colorTo(b, heatc(0.04 + 0.96 * (b.p / den) / mc), 1700, 1000); }
        } else { tw(b, 'h', b.p * HS, 0, 700); tw(b, 'op', 0.13, 0, 700); colorTo(b, b.hc, 0, 600); tw(b, 'lab', 0, 0, 300); }
      });
      wall = Math.max(wall, ...bars.filter(inSlice).map(b => den > 0 ? b.p / den : 0));
      camTo(isX ? 6 : 84, 13, 0, 1300);
      const given = isX ? `${XN} = ${val}` : `${YN} = ${val}`, other = isX ? YN : XN, ov = isX ? '<em>y</em>' : '<em>x</em>';
      cap.innerHTML = `Conditional PMF of ${other} given ${given}: take the slice ${given}, then divide by P(${given}) = ${f3(den)} so the slice sums to 1. ` +
        `P(${other} = ${ov} | ${given}) = P(${isX ? `${XN} = ${val}, ${YN} = <em>y</em>` : `${XN} = <em>x</em>, ${YN} = ${val}`}) / P(${given}).`;
    }
    tw(cam, 'wallH', Math.min(1, Math.ceil(wall * 10 - 1e-9) / 10 + 0.1), 0, 900);
    tw(cam, 'cz', Math.min(1, Math.ceil(wall * 10 - 1e-9) / 10 + 0.1) * HS * 0.42, 0, 900);
    drawTable(); go();
  }

  // ---------- table ----------
  function drawTable() {
    const hlRow = mode === 'cx' ? sel : -1, hlCol = mode === 'cy' ? sel : -1;
    const cls = (i, j) => (i === hlRow || j === hlCol) ? P + '-hl' : ((hlRow >= 0 || hlCol >= 0) ? P + '-dim' : '');
    let h = `<table><tr><th>${XN} \\ ${YN}</th>${YV.map(v => `<th>${v}</th>`).join('')}<th class="${P}-m">P(${XN}=<em>x</em>)</th></tr>`;
    pm.forEach((r, i) => {
      h += `<tr><th>${XV[i]}</th>${r.map((v, j) => { const on = !CFG.heat || (hlRow < 0 && hlCol < 0) || i === hlRow || j === hlCol;
        return `<td class="${CFG.heat ? '' : cls(i, j)}"${on ? cellSty(v, HM) : ''}>${f3(v)}</td>`; }).join('')}` +
           `<td class="${P}-m ${mode === 'mx' ? P + '-hm' : (i === hlRow ? P + '-hm' : '')}">${f3(pX[i])}</td></tr>`;
    });
    h += `<tr class="${P}-mr"><th>P(${YN}=<em>y</em>)</th>${pY.map((v, j) => `<td class="${mode === 'my' || j === hlCol ? P + '-hm' : ''}">${f3(v)}</td>`).join('')}<td class="${P}-m">1</td></tr></table>`;
    if (CFG.heat) h += `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px 2px 0;font-size:13px;color:#7b8794">0` +
      `<div style="flex:0 0 150px;height:10px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,${STOPS.map(rgbs).join(',')})"></div>${f3(HM)} &nbsp;darker = higher</div>`;
    tabBox.innerHTML = h;
    let c = '';
    if (mode === 'cx' || mode === 'cy') {
      const isX = mode === 'cx', den = isX ? pX[sel] : pY[sel], vals = isX ? YV : XV, given = isX ? `${XN}=${XV[sel]}` : `${YN}=${YV[sel]}`;
      const cp = vals.map((_, k) => (isX ? pm[sel][k] : pm[k][sel]) / den);
      c = `<table><tr><th>${isX ? YN : XN}</th>${vals.map(v => `<th>${v}</th>`).join('')}<th class="${P}-m">sum</th></tr>` +
          `<tr><th>P(&middot; | ${given})</th>${cp.map(v => `<td class="${CFG.heat ? '' : P + '-hl'}"${cellSty(v, Math.max(...cp))}>${f3(v)}</td>`).join('')}<td class="${P}-m">1</td></tr></table>`;
    }
    condBox.innerHTML = c;
  }

  // ---------- controls ----------
  const modeBox = root.querySelector('[data-role=mode]'), valBox = root.querySelector('[data-role=vals]');
  function buttons(box, opts, onPick) {
    box.innerHTML = ''; const bs = [];
    opts.forEach(([k, l]) => { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.innerHTML = l; b.dataset.k = k;
      b.onclick = () => { if (b.classList.contains(P + '-on')) return; bs.forEach(x => x.classList.toggle(P + '-on', x === b)); onPick(k); };
      bs.push(b); box.appendChild(b); });
    return bs;
  }
  function showVals(isX) {
    if (isX === null) { valBox.classList.add(P + '-off'); return; }
    valBox.classList.remove(P + '-off');
    const vals = isX ? XV : YV, def = CFG.defaultCond[isX ? 0 : 1];
    const bs = buttons(valBox, vals.map((v, k) => [k, `${isX ? XN : YN} = ${v}`]), k => setMode(isX ? 'cx' : 'cy', +k));
    bs[def].classList.add(P + '-on'); return def;
  }
  const mbs = buttons(modeBox, [['joint', 'Joint'], ['mx', `Marginal of ${XN}`], ['my', `Marginal of ${YN}`], ['cx', `Given ${XN}`], ['cy', `Given ${YN}`]], k => {
    if (k === 'cx' || k === 'cy') setMode(k, showVals(k === 'cx')); else { showVals(null); setMode(k); }
  });
  mbs[0].classList.add(P + '-on'); showVals(null);

  // ---------- rotate by dragging; hover readout ----------
  let drag = null;
  svg.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { drag = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; svg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); tweens = tweens.filter(w => w.obj !== cam || w.key === 'wallH' || w.key === 'cz'); });
  svg.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    if (drag) {
      const k = W / svg.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      cam.a = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, cam.a - (e.clientX - drag.x) * 0.35 * k));
      cam.e = Math.max(8, Math.min(60, cam.e + (e.clientY - drag.y) * 0.3 * k));
      drag = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; if (!raf) render(); return;
    }
    const t = e.target, i = t.getAttribute && t.getAttribute('data-i');
    if (i === null || i === undefined) { info.innerHTML = '&nbsp;'; return; }
    const j = +t.getAttribute('data-j'), b = bars.find(z => z.i === +i && z.j === j);
    let s = `P(${XN} = ${XV[b.i]}, ${YN} = ${YV[b.j]}) = ${f3(b.p)}` + (CFG.n ? ` &nbsp;(${Math.round(b.p * CFG.n)} of ${CFG.n} students)` : '');
    if (mode === 'cx' && b.i === sel) s += ` &nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp; P(${YN} = ${YV[b.j]} | ${XN} = ${XV[sel]}) = ${f3(b.p)} / ${f3(pX[sel])} = ${f3(b.p / pX[sel])}`;
    if (mode === 'cy' && b.j === sel) s += ` &nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp; P(${XN} = ${XV[b.i]} | ${YN} = ${YV[sel]}) = ${f3(b.p)} / ${f3(pY[sel])} = ${f3(b.p / pY[sel])}`;
    info.innerHTML = s;
  });
  const end = () => { drag = null; };
  svg.addEventListener('pointerup', end); svg.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!drag) info.innerHTML = '&nbsp;'; });

  setMode('joint');
})();

r = 0: correlation only measures linear dependence", "note": "r = 0 but fully dependent", "r": -0.0, "cov": -3.8507392211210616e-11, "cunit": "cm³", "cdec": 1, "n": 299, "jit": null, "dec": false}]};
  const P = 'srel', CFG = CFG_P;
  const root = document.getElementById(P + '-root');
  const W = 760, H = 470, m = { l: 62, r: 20, t: 16, b: 54 };
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
  const [x0, x1] = CFG.xdom;
  const sx = v => m.l + (v - x0) / (x1 - x0) * pw;
  const syP = (pr, v) => m.t + ph - (v - pr.ydom[0]) / (pr.ydom[1] - pr.ydom[0]) * ph;
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const el = (t, a, p) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, t);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); if (p) p.appendChild(e); return e; };
  const ease = t => t < .5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

  // ---------- controls ----------
  const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = P + '-bar'; root.appendChild(bar);
  const sg = document.createElement('div'); sg.className = P + '-seg'; bar.appendChild(sg);
  const bs = {};
  CFG.pairs.forEach(pr => {
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.textContent = pr.label;
    b.onclick = () => { if (cur === pr.key) return; show(pr.key); };
    bs[pr.key] = b; sg.appendChild(b);
  });
  const cap = document.createElement('div'); cap.className = P + '-cap'; root.appendChild(cap);

  // ---------- svg + per-pair axes ----------
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: 'img', 'aria-label': CFG.title }, root);
  const xAx = el('g', {}, svg);
  CFG.xticks.forEach(v => {
    el('line', { x1: sx(v), x2: sx(v), y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#edf0f3' }, xAx);
    el('text', { x: sx(v), y: m.t + ph + 22, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-tick' }, xAx).textContent = v;
  });
  el('text', { x: m.l + pw / 2, y: H - 8, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab' }, xAx).textContent = CFG.xlab;
  const yAxes = {};
  CFG.pairs.forEach(pr => {
    const g = el('g', { class: P + '-ax', opacity: 0 }, svg); yAxes[pr.key] = g;
    pr.yticks.forEach(v => {
      el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: syP(pr, v), y2: syP(pr, v), stroke: '#edf0f3' }, g);
      el('text', { x: m.l - 10, y: syP(pr, v) + 4.5, 'text-anchor': 'end', class: P + '-tick' }, g).textContent = pr.dec ? v.toFixed(1) : v;
    });
    el('text', { x: 16, y: m.t + ph / 2, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab',
                 transform: `rotate(-90 16 ${m.t + ph / 2})` }, g).textContent = pr.ylab;
  });
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: m.t + ph, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l, y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);

  // ---------- dots ----------
  const R = CFG.r || 4.3, OP = CFG.op || 0.6;
  const dg = el('g', {}, svg);
  const N = CFG.x.length;
  const dots = CFG.x.map((x, i) => ({ x: sx(x), y: m.t + ph / 2, o: 0,
    c: el('circle', { r: R, fill: CFG.color, opacity: 0, cx: sx(x), cy: m.t + ph / 2 }, dg) }));

  // fit line + r read-out
  const rb = el('text', { x: m.l + 14, y: m.t + 40, class: P + '-rbig' }, svg);
  const rs = el('text', { x: m.l + 14, y: m.t + 62, class: P + '-rsub' }, svg);
  const rc = el('text', { x: m.l + 14, y: m.t + 84, class: P + '-rsub' }, svg);
  let rVal = 0, cVal = 0;

  const targets = pr => {
    const ys = pr.vals.map((v, i) => v == null ? null : syP(pr, v + (pr.jit ? pr.jit[i] : 0)));
    return { ys };
  };

  const cfmt = pr => pr.cdec == null ? 1 : pr.cdec;
  let cur = null, raf = 0;
  function show(key, instant) {
    const pr = CFG.pairs.find(p => p.key === key), T = targets(pr);
    for (const k in bs) bs[k].classList.toggle(P + '-on', k === key);
    for (const k in yAxes) yAxes[k].setAttribute('opacity', k === key ? 1 : 0);
    cap.textContent = pr.caption;
    rs.textContent = pr.note + '  (n = ' + pr.n + ')';
    cur = key;
    const from = dots.map(d => ({ y: d.y, o: d.o })), r0 = rVal, c0 = cVal;
    const dur = instant ? 1 : 1100, t0 = performance.now();
    // dots missing a value keep their old y and fade out
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    const step = now => {
      const u = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur), e = ease(u);
      dots.forEach((d, i) => {
        const ty = T.ys[i];
        if (ty != null) { d.y = from[i].y + (ty - from[i].y) * e; d.o = from[i].o + (OP - from[i].o) * e; }
        else { d.y = from[i].y; d.o = from[i].o * (1 - e); }
        d.c.setAttribute('cy', d.y); d.c.setAttribute('opacity', d.o);
      });
      rVal = r0 + (pr.r - r0) * e;
      rb.textContent = 'r = ' + (rVal < -0.005 ? '−' : '') + Math.abs(rVal).toFixed(2);
      cVal = c0 + (pr.cov - c0) * e;
      rc.textContent = 'Cov = ' + (cVal < -0.005 ? '−' : '') + Math.abs(cVal).toFixed(cfmt(pr)) + (pr.cunit ? ' ' + pr.cunit : '');
      if (u < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  show(CFG.pairs[0].key, true);
})();
</script>
